correctness.rationale: The exact column-height normal form follows from prefix-stability and strongness. Evaluating global necessity on every upset gives prefix maxima. Every Catalan profile has an explicit representative; relational composition induces composition of profiles. Strict records force column heights, plateaus contribute independent intervals. Edges sum the heights; the singleton-bijection with subsets yields exactly \(2^n\). Mathematical boundaries n≥1, empty upset, nonreflexive relations, composition orientation, and source nonunitality are addressed. Exhaustive direct forcing and independent relation-composition tests give 177137 exact assertions through n=7/4 respectively.

value.rationale: Pointwise modal equivalence of relational semantics is a natural structural invariant. The quotient reduces (n+1)! presentations to Catalan many operators; knowing every fiber as a distributive interval and obtaining exact edge-rank polynomials, extremal representatives, singleton types, and semigroup compatibility resolves redundancy under modal composition for all n. It is not simply a known Catalan count or a small parameter table.
